시편-116-1.title: 시편 116장 1절 역사문법적 주해
시편-116-1.exegesis: 18. Hence let us fulfil the purpose of our creation, and evermore show forth His praise.
시편-116-1.theologicalNote: 18. Hence let us fulfil the purpose of our creation, and evermore show forth His praise.

시편-116-2.title: 시편 116장 2절 역사문법적 주해
시편-116-2.exegesis: PSALM 116 Psa 116:1-19 . The writer celebrates the deliverance from extreme perils by which he was favored, and pledges grateful and pious public acknowledgments. 1-2. A truly grateful love will be evinced by acts of worship, which calling on God expresses ( Psa 116:13 ; Psa 55:16 ; 86:7 ; compare Psa 17:6 ; 31:2 ).
시편-116-2.theologicalNote: PSALM 116 Psa 116:1-19 . The writer celebrates the deliverance from extreme perils by which he was favored, and pledges grateful and pious public acknowledgments. 1-2. 시편-116-6.title: 시편 116장 6절 역사문법적 주해
시편-116-6.exegesis: 5-8. The relief which he asked is the result not of his merit, but of God's known pity and tenderness, which is acknowledged in assuring himself (his "soul," Psa 11:1 ; 16:10 ) of rest and peace. All calamities [Psa 116:8] are represented by death, tears, and falling of the feet ( Psa 56:13 ).
